name: memory_inspector
description: Inspects Stella's durable memory store: lists every remembered fact with its tags and timestamp, searches by keyword, reports the count, and (with confirm=true) can clear the store. Never invents memories - reports exactly what is on disk, or that nothing is stored.

operation.description: One of: list | search | count | clear. Defaults to list.

query.description: Keyword to search memories by (for the search operation).

limit.description: Maximum facts to return. Defaults to 100.

confirm.description: Must be true to actually clear the store. Defaults to false.

author: Stella
notes: Reads agent/memory.py's memories.jsonl under the user data dir. Clearing is destructive: needs confirm=true and reports the count removed.
